description: Comprehensive test suite for Phase 3 HTTP routing: unit tests for route matching/params/ctx/groups/static/errors/CORS/responses, and integration test that starts a real HTTP server and makes requests to verify end-to-end behavior.
steps: Create tests/test_router.nim with unittest suites covering: (1) Route Registration - register static routes, parameterized routes, multiple methods, verify route count and ordering. (2) Route Matching - exact static path match, parameterized path match with extraction, multiple params, no-match returns nil, method mismatch. (3) Path Parameter Extraction - single param :id, multiple params :user_id/:id, params are strings. (4) Ctx Object Population - build ctx from mock request data, verify params/form/query/headers tables are populated. (5) Group Auth Propagation - routes in auth:required group get auth requirement, nested groups override. (6) Response Helpers - render stub returns 200 with template path in body, redirect returns 302 with Location, explicit response returns custom status/body/type. (7) Static File Serving - serve CSS with text/css type, serve JS with application/javascript, serve non-existent file returns 404, gzip Content-Encoding header present. (8) HTMX Embedded - serve from /__doot/htmx.min.js, correct content-type, body is non-empty. (9) Error Handling - auto-404 when find returns None, default 404 page has styled HTML, default 500 page has styled HTML, custom error page used if file exists. (10) CORS Denial - request with Origin header gets 403, request without Origin proceeds normally.

Create tests/test_http_integration.nim with an integration test that: (1) Creates a RouteTable with several routes (static GET, parameterized GET, POST with form), (2) Starts the HTTP server on a random high port in a background thread, (3) Makes actual HTTP requests using std/httpclient, (4) Verifies: GET /hello returns 200 with expected body, GET /posts/42 returns 200 with params extracted, POST /posts with form data returns expected response, GET /nonexistent returns 404, GET /__doot/htmx.min.js returns HTMX content, Cross-origin request gets 403. (5) Shuts down the server cleanly after tests.

If mummy's threading model makes integration testing complex, provide an alternative approach: test route matching and ctx building in isolation (unit tests only), and provide a manual integration test script that can be run separately.
Update doot.nimble test task to include: exec "nim c --threads:on --mm:orc -r tests/test_router.nim" and exec "nim c --threads:on --mm:orc -r tests/test_http_integration.nim"
Run all tests (Phase 1+2+3) and confirm everything passes
acceptance_criteria: tests/test_router.nim has at least 40 test cases covering all 10 suites listed above
tests/test_http_integration.nim has at least 8 integration test cases making real HTTP requests
